verdict.rationale: Gitea ships its own workflow engine, Gitea Actions, whose YAML workflow syntax is documented as compatible with GitHub Actions. That implies, but does not explicitly document, support for recurring scheduled triggers, so recurring scheduling is inferred rather than evidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation of schedule/cron triggers in Gitea Actions, evidence that recurring runs actually execute (hands-on or independent corroboration), details on schedule management or limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.
Workflow and action syntax is compatible with GitHub Actions.
We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
